requirementFit.summary: The module render() helper is the single activation point (all router paths converge there); the write-set covers the core, router, both consumer pages and their tests; no other dormant componentDidMount definitions exist in src.

implementationQuality.summary: Round 1's five findings closed with verified facts: remount contract (CDM once per instance, setProps on same-route revisit, leave→destroy→fresh CDM), the real double-fetch safety basis (synchronous socket dedup + Store content dedup) with a pinned measurable fetch profile, per-instance guard with full short-circuit and no destroy reset, LIVE-3 regression intent preserved in the chat page test, and the named dispatch↔destroy symmetry invariant.

evidenceQuality.summary: EV-CDM-1 gains a scripted call-site grep; AC-CDM-3 pins exact counts (2 GET /chats cold, ≤2 getToken per chat, 1 WS per chat, 1 GET on SPA navigation) — all three copies of the criterion (acceptance-criteria, manifest, final audit gate) reconciled to the same profile after the round-2 residual.

residualRisk.summary: Block edits stay limited to dispatch recursion and the guard (SEC-CORE-MINIMAL); exactly one existing test breaks by design (the constructor-fetch LIVE-3 test, migrated with its intent preserved); bootstrap ordering verified safe (CDM fires with a hydrated store).

rounds.summary: Five findings: remount semantics not pinned (F-1 MEDIUM), double-fetch idempotency claim unfounded and an unmeasurable smoke criterion (F-2 MEDIUM), guard semantics misleading (F-3 LOW), the migrated chat test would weaken the LIVE-3 regression (F-4 LOW), dispatch/destroy symmetry unnamed (F-5 LOW). Architecture approved: activation point unique, recursion complete (refs ⊆ _hbsChildren), bootstrap ordering safe.

All five closures verified against the code line by line (setProps-only revisit, leave→destroy, synchronous socket dedup without TOCTOU, Store content suppression, lifecycle handler off in destroy, wholesale _hbsChildren replacement). One LOW residual (OF-1): AC-CDM-3 copies diverged — the acceptance-criteria mirror stayed qualitative and the manifest lost the ≤2 getToken bound; closed in the freeze revision by reconciling all three copies to the full measurable profile. Reviewer pre-approved freeze after that single edit.
